page.faq_01: What level is this course for?
page.faq_02: This course suits both beginners and people studying French at a higher level who still struggle with articles. We cover the entire system from the basics, so you can understand the logic no matter your level.
page.faq_04: Across five episodes, you'll explore definite, indefinite and partitive articles, the use of de, fixed expressions and cases where no article is needed. Above all, you'll learn the logic of choosing an article, not just memorise rules.
page.faq_06: Watch short video lessons, analyse examples and reinforce what you've learnt with interactive exercises. It's all woven into a mystery adventure with Gustave and Alf, as you help bring the lights back to Paris!
page.faq_07: Do I have to complete everything at once?
page.faq_08: Not at all! Go at your own pace. You can revisit explanations, rewatch videos and repeat exercises as often as you like.
page.faq_09: How long will I have access to the course?
page.faq_10: For life! All videos, exercises and resources remain available after the mystery is solved. Come back whenever you like.
page.faq_12: You can buy the full course for 25 € or choose the same course with an additional donation to support Alf. In the second option, you choose the donation amount, which is added to the course price. Both options include the same content and access.
page.faq_13: Can I support Alf without buying the course?
page.faq_14: Of course! ❤️ If you don't need the course but want to help Alf, simply choose a donation amount. Your support contributes towards his heart surgery. This option does not include access to the course.
page.faq_18: Here are answers to the most common questions. If you can't find what you need, message us: we're here to help! ❤️
